about: Pompano Beach Arts, the city's Cultural Affairs Department, presents Light Up MLK as a free community celebration that invites everyone to gather, connect and feel the spirit of the season together.

The city's event page describes an unforgettable evening of live performances, delicious bites, games and giveaways, ending with the ceremonial lighting that officially kicks off the holiday season in true Pompano style.
The celebration is held at Annie Adderly Gillis Park, 601 Dr M.L.K. Jr Blvd, in the MLK corridor, and the event is listed under the Ali Cultural Arts Center programs.
The page links a free Eventbrite registration for families who want to reserve a spot. Admission is free.

Light Up MLK is the first listing in the city's 'Tis the Season holiday series that runs from November 14 to December 12 and includes Black Nativity, Yuletide on Atlantic, the Untapped tree lighting, a Hanukkah festival, the Holiday Boat Parade and Donuts with Santa.
Families planning the rest of the series can pair this evening with Yuletide on Atlantic on December 3, the Old Town tree lighting on December 4 and Donuts with Santa on December 12.
